capabilities: Copy the current file's absolute path from a tab-header button
Run a Copy path of current file command and bind a hotkey to it
Configure a copy template using {{path}}, {{relative}}, and {{wikilink}} tokens
extras: Desktop only; the README states absolute paths do not exist on mobile. Manual installation instructions are given instead of a community-plugin listing flow.
problem: Copying a note's path normally requires right-clicking in the file explorer and navigating a context menu; there is no one-click control on the open note itself.
summary: Tab-header button that copies the current note's file path in one click, with a command, hotkey support, and a configurable copy template.
